scope: Unique retained native receipts by full receipt hash, including reproduction; legacy field operators are counted separately, not assumed to be processes. CPU totals exclude unretained exploratory invocations, host orchestration, research tests and final proof comparison. Preservation job CPU includes its source-bound full test suite. This is a measured lower bound, not a complete process-accounting claim. Group bytes exclude checkout, packs, restoration copies, root logs and this census.
